sections.title: Принятое решение владельца
sections.text:
CoreX прекращает поддержку Laravel12 по явному решению владельца. Текущая поддерживаемая платформа: PHP8.4–8.5 × Laravel13; Composer php ^8.4 сохраняется, first-party laravel/framework и illuminate/* — ^13.0, Testbench — ^11.3 (core — ^11.5 при его прямом объявлении). Pest5.2.1/PHPUnit13.3.4/Infection0.35.6 и их существующие root lock versions не понижаются. Compatibility preflight P09.9: две PHP version cells × SQLite/PostgreSQL = четыре реальные строки. MSI95/90/75, raw Pest/coverage XML/JUnit, uncovered/timeout/error controls и D125 repository-only scope неизменны. Это явное одобрение сужения platform contract и необходимых Composer/CI/docs/CHANGELOG изменений в P09.9; версии/каналы/release metadata не меняются. Два семейства тестовых стеков из D131 не нужны. Данное решение имеет приоритет только над Laravel12 matrix/minimum-platform положениями D03/D120 и прежнего досье; PHP, остальные quality/BC/API/SPI/schema положения сохраняются. Никакие другие items, в частности P09.5, и release-работы не запускаются.

Owner: «проще отказаться от laravel 12, мы стараемся поддерживать современный стек». Existing partial Laravel13 runtime proof is historical; fresh acceptance remains mandatory.

sections.title: Готовый контракт только P09.9
sections.text:
Scope: only P09.9. D132 accepts Laravel13-only; there is no unresolved version-policy question. Reconcile current first-party package/product manifests to Laravel/Illuminate ^13.0 and Testbench ^11.3 (direct Testbench-core ^11.5), keeping PHP ^8.4, stable flags, branch aliases, monorepo lockstep, package versions and pinned Pest5.2.1/PHPUnit13.3.4/Infection0.35.6 unchanged. Third-party AzGuard repository metadata is upstream evidence and is not rewritten. Inspect direct framework/test-stack declarations in every owned manifest. Add an explicit platform-support entry to each affected package/product CHANGELOG. Preserve all unrelated changes.

Update scripts/manifest-check.py policy and enforce framework/illuminate/Testbench floors without accepting Laravel12-only or old Testbench10 fixtures. Use disposable copied manifests for negative checks; report real RED diagnostics. Reconcile active ordinary .github/workflows/ci.yml matrices to PHP8.4/8.5 × Laravel13; remove conditional Laravel12 Pest4/Testbench10 installs while retaining both PHP lanes, SQLite/PG coverage, audits, action pins and permissions. README/docs/dev-doctrine and current package docs must stop advertising Laravel12 support. Historical captured manifests/receipts and upstream Laravel12 explanatory comments/fixtures are retained. Release qualification workflows, candidates, split/tag/publication stay outside D125 scope. Do not run Rector across product sources or add Laravel13-only behavior transformations.

Keep root package records and tool pins unchanged: root lock content-hash is reconciled with the finite manifest constraint changes; only local first-party path records may change require/require-dev metadata and corresponding source references after capture/review. No upstream locked version update. Root Pest/Infection adapter code and its ^5.2.1/^13.3.4 requirements stay valid; no Pest4 compatibility expansion and no new separate Laravel12/13 vendors/locks are needed. A targeted lock refresh that wants unrelated upstream updates is refused and investigated. Use existing pinned tool versions and no Composer replace/alias/platform-ignore or security-ignore workaround.

Change infection-compatibility.json laravel list to [13] and bump receipt/policy schema version for the new declared matrix. The spike selects PHP8.4/8.5 × Laravel13 × sqlite/pgsql; check_rows validates exactly four unique rows and recorded runtime Laravel13. All engine versions remain exact. Derive expected cells from the current declared policy, not a hardcoded eight-row constant; remove only obsolete Laravel12 requirements. Old v1/eight-row/incompatible reports remain rejected. Bind new policy, manifest/lock/source/test/adapter/binary/flag hashes. Preserve 19 existing receipt negatives and add unsupported Laravel12/wrong PHP/missing fourth row/duplicate driver/wrong engine/stale old-policy negatives. No fabricated raw XML/JUnit or weakened generated-class/assertion/trace checks.

Fresh acceptance after repository reconciliation: same nine real tenancy DatabaseValue cases + actual Laravel/PDO temporary-table probe + three controls, 13 cases/25 assertions per row. Actual Pest CLI, raw coverage XML/JUnit and actual Infection0.35.6 generated mutants in all four rows. Preserve --with-uncovered --with-timeouts --threads=1 --log-verbosity=all --debug. Four real package mutants killed plus one escaped/uncovered/timeout/exit137 control per row; timeout and error controls are separately diagnosed, never counted as kills or production MSI. Unexpected infrastructure/coverage/bootstrap/DB errors block. Run devops:db-test-preflight before serial PG; actual *_test DB only and connection-local temporary tables, no application migrations/reset.

Run the contract V1–V9. V6 validates strict first-party manifests and the finite root lock refresh; V8 verifies ordinary CI configuration and PHP8.4/8.5 Laravel13 Composer solves/platform checks in isolated snapshots, no hosted dispatch. Collect new raw outputs in build/quality/infection-spike-laravel13 and archive to artifacts/P09.9-execution-after-D132; never overwrite P09.9-execution or either design dossier. Budget remains 2h preflight + at most 2h bounded adapter repair; block with raw evidence at limit. P09.9 has no production MSI claim; MSI security95/messaging90/other75 denominator/error/equivalence rules stay unchanged. Stop after P09.9; no automatic P09.5/release successor.

provenance.note: D132 owner amendment resolves the version-policy question; this design does not execute P09.9.
